newsitem.title: GREECE: Athens Medical sees 97 profit up 23pct.
newsitem.headline: Athens Medical sees 97 profit up 23pct.

text.p: Athens Medical Centre expects 1997 pretax profit growth of 23 percent at 4.25 billion drachmas from an estimated 3.45 billion in 1996.
Turnover in 1997 is expected to grow to 15 billion drachmas from an expected 12.8 billion in 1996, the company's economic advisor Yannis Andricopoulos told Reuters.

"We expect 1997 pretax profits of 4.25 billion drachmas from an estimated 3.45 billion in 1996," said Andricopoulos. "Our 1997 turnover is projected at 15 billion drachmas from 12.8 billion in 1996. It should be noted that 1995 and 1996 figures are in line with our earlier projections."
Athens Medical Centre posted 1995 pretax earnings of 2.55 billion drachmas and turnover of 10.4 billion drachmas, he said.

Athens Medical Centre Paleo Faliro will post 1997 pretax profits of 830 million drachmas, up 28 percent from an estimated 650 million drachmas in 1996 and 500 million drachmas in 1995, Andricopoulos said.
The 1997 turnover of Paleo faliro Clinic is projected to be close to 3.0 billion drachmas from an expected 2.34 billion in 1996 and 1.9 billion in 1995, he added.
Paleo Faliro Clinic is a recent parallel market listing and a subsidiary of Athens Medical Centre.
Andricopoulos said the Athens Medical Centre Group's turnover was projected to be around 20 billion drachmas in 1997 from an estimated 15.5 billion in 1996 and 12.5 billion in 1995.
"The group's 1997 pretax earnings are projected at 5.3 billion drachmas from an expected 4.1 billion in 1996 and 2.9 billion in 1995," he said.
Based on a closing price of 1,800 drachmas on Wednesday, up 50 drachmas on Tuesday, and the forecasts, the P/E ratio for Athens Medical Centre stood at 6.91 and 5.61 for 1996 and 1997 respectively.

The price-earnings multiple for the Athens Medical Centre Paleo Faliro Clinic was 6.67 for 1996 and 5.23 for 1997 based on today's closing price of 1,870 drachmas, up 70 drachmas on Tuesday, and the firm's projections.
